entities.summary: Amrita Patel is an Indian businessperson associated with the cooperative dairy sector as well as an environmentalist. She headed the National Dairy Development Board from 1998 to 2014 which led the world's biggest dairy development program Operation Flood. She chaired several other institutes and has been a member of board of banks. She was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2001. Amrita Patel was a performers & entertainers from New Delhi (b. 1943-11-13, New Delhi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
